licence: GNU GPL version 3 or later (Script_Thread.cpp header), with id Software additional terms cited in the header (line 22; terms text not in the box, not read)
best_idea: A parked script holds exactly one wake condition (a time, an entity's done notice, or another script's end), and each wake cancels the pending resume before posting a new one, so a script runs once per wake.
decision_why: Keep one wake per park and the cancel-then-repost rule on the server; store waiters per entity, yield and count over-budget resumes instead of stopping the server, and make a zero-length wait due at once. Reject the idThread and interpreter code (copyleft, clean-room only) and the objective list as written (keys by display title, no ids).
acceptance: A server test runs a quest step 'wait 2 s, then wait for door 7': the step resumes at 2 s and again when door 7 reports done; two scripts waiting on door 7 both resume; a script that spends its budget yields and continues on the next advance; no script runs twice for one wake.
